items.proposition: The earliest observable company-first hierarchy departure varies across runs: the report locates it in Idea, Synthesis, or Narrative.
sourceQuotes: The first visible editorial hierarchy break varies by run.
In Experiment 008 Company-first runs, selected Idea already changes the hierarchy in A-001 and A-003
candidate 003 is already company/product hierarchy drift in Synthesis.
Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the available records.
items.materiality: This directly supports a variable starting point rather than a single stage being the universal first location.
items.boundary: These are the report’s localizations of observable departures; they do not establish the internal cause of any departure.

items.proposition: Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the reviewed records, but it is not the first locus in every reported case.
sourceQuotes: Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift in the available records.
It is first in 007 runs 001–002, 008 A-002 (factual breach) and 009 baseline 002/003 and candidates 001–003.
But it is not a sole root cause: some runs start in Idea or Synthesis, and in 009 baseline 001 the reported factual issue is Compose.
items.materiality: Preserves the distinction between recurrence and universality, central to the selected Idea’s qualification.
items.boundary: Recurrence does not establish Narrative as a universal root cause or as the first failure for every dimension.

items.proposition: Experiment 008 reports company-first hierarchy changes already in selected Idea for runs A-001 and A-003.
sourceQuotes: A-001 | **Idea** | Compose is selected as the “concrete expression” framing Nuëyon’s identity
A-003 | **Idea** | Selected Idea calls Compose an “orchestration-first philosophy”
items.materiality: Provides direct examples of an early, Idea-stage departure, showing that observed drift is not confined to Narrative.
items.boundary: These examples concern the named Experiment 008 runs; they do not show that Idea is generally the first departure.

items.proposition: Experiment 007 candidate 003 is localized to Synthesis as the earliest supported hierarchy departure in the available trace.
sourceQuotes: Candidate 003 | **Synthesis** | Primary message and subject make Compose/orchestration the story; broader company identity and audience become context.
We can localize drift only from Synthesis onward for those chains
items.materiality: Adds a Synthesis-stage example to the range of reported first observable locations.
items.boundary: The report does not assess Idea or Research for these chains, so it cannot establish whether the departure began before Synthesis.

items.proposition: The report defines “first drift” as an earliest observable departure, not as evidence of internal model causation.
sourceQuotes: For each run, “first drift” means the earliest **observable** stage that departs from the requested company-first editorial hierarchy, introduces unsupported material, or makes a materially stronger claim.
It does not imply internal model causation.
items.materiality: Prevents interpreting stage localization as proof of where or why the underlying process caused the behavior.
items.boundary: The report supports stage-level observations under its stated definition, not a causal account of model behavior.

items.proposition: Experiment 009 reports that company-first selected Ideas did not ensure the company-first hierarchy survived downstream.
sourceQuotes: Experiment 009 shows that a company-first selected Idea is not sufficient.
The evaluation reports the selected Idea kept Nuëyon primary and Compose as first product direction in all six baseline/candidate runs.
The reported issues then appear downstream: orchestration-centered story framing, unsupported audience/validation/outcome language, or a factual overclaim in Compose.
items.materiality: Shows a downstream departure can occur even when the selected Idea is reported as company-first, complementing the early-stage examples.
items.boundary: This is the report’s summary of six runs; it does not show that every downstream stage or every run failed in the same way.

items.proposition: Experiment 009 baseline 001 is reported as a Compose-stage factual failure while earlier stages remain company-first and downstream hierarchy is scored 2/2.
sourceQuotes: Baseline 001 | **Compose** (reported factual failure)
Selected Idea and earlier chain remain company-first; the artifact’s score gives downstream hierarchy 2/2.
reliable conversion is not established.
items.materiality: Distinguishes a factual failure at Compose from a hierarchy departure and prevents treating every late-stage problem as evidence of hierarchy drift.
items.boundary: This example does not establish Compose as the first hierarchy-departure stage; the report explicitly says the earlier chain remains company-first.

items.proposition: The report treats source fidelity and editorial hierarchy as separate dimensions: a technically supported description can still be the wrong lead for a company introduction.
sourceQuotes: Factual and editorial failures are distinct.
Orchestration is source-supported as a Compose design principle; making it the defining story of a company introduction can still violate the source’s editorial intent.
The source supports two true propositions that compete editorially: Nuëyon is an AI-first company; orchestration is central to Compose’s design.
items.materiality: Clarifies that factual support alone does not determine whether an output preserves the requested company-first hierarchy.
items.boundary: This is the report’s stated editorial interpretation; it does not make the supported orchestration proposition factually false.

items.proposition: Technical-first framing in Experiment 008 B runs is treated as expected under that condition, not by itself as a company-first hierarchy departure.
sourceQuotes: Technical-first B runs intentionally start technical, so their first technical framing in Idea is expected by that condition
In technical-first Experiment 008 B runs, technical hierarchy itself is the intended condition; the table identifies any separate scope/factual breach.
items.materiality: Provides a contrast case showing that technical framing must be interpreted against the run’s intended condition before classifying it as drift.
items.boundary: Expected technical ordering under B does not demonstrate that the output satisfies a company-first introduction or that its factual claims are sound.

items.proposition: The report cautions that Experiment 009’s saved evaluation does not formally assign a first-failure stage to each dimension, and identifies baseline 003 localization as lower confidence.
sourceQuotes: Its saved evaluation summarizes the six runs but does not assign a formal first-failure stage to each dimension.
where the exact factual precursor is not explicitly called out (notably baseline 003), the localization is lower confidence.
items.materiality: Qualifies the precision of per-run stage localization, particularly where a report summary rather than a formal stage-by-dimension assignment is the basis.
items.boundary: This limitation does not negate the report’s broader cross-run observations; it limits confidence in some specific localizations.

items.proposition: Upstream format references are reported as an architectural inconsistency and a plausible source of format priming, but not as a demonstrated cause of drift.
sourceQuotes: These are direct format references in upstream prompt text.
This is an instruction-boundary inconsistency and a plausible source of format priming
It does **not** demonstrate that these references caused orchestration drift or a weak hook in any given run.
items.materiality: Separates an observed prompt-boundary issue from the unproven causal explanation of particular run outcomes.
items.boundary: The report does not establish that format references caused any specific hierarchy departure.

ideaChecks.proposition: The earliest visible departure from the intended company-first hierarchy varies across runs; Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift, but the evidence does not establish it—or any other stage—as a universal root cause.

limitations: Experiment 007 has no Idea or Research extracts for the cited chains; the report says localization is possible only from Synthesis onward.
Experiment 009’s saved evaluation does not formally assign first-failure stages by dimension, and the report marks baseline 003 localization as lower confidence.
The map reflects the supplied diagnostic report’s descriptions of reviewed artifacts; the underlying run artifacts are not separately available here for reinspection.
